retrievalProfile.description: A dual-portrait composition blending realistic 1980s fashion photography with an airbrushed cosmic landscape and futuristic city elements.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring two male figures at different scales against a surreal cosmic backdrop. The foreground figure is a large, detailed portrait with magenta rim lighting, while the background figure is full-bodied, holding a glowing device. The environment merges a dark, winding road with a glowing futuristic city and a starry sky containing a large planet.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground portrait versus background full-body figure
Organic human subjects against a synthetic airbrushed environment
Dark asphalt road leading into a glowing yellow horizon
Magenta and cyan rim lighting contrasting with deep space blacks
coreInvariants: Deep black space background with white star clusters
Magenta-tinted rim lighting on skin and clothing
A large, soft-edged planet with a horizontal ring or line
Futuristic dome-like structures in the mid-ground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up portrait on the left third; smaller full-body figure on the right third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large face on the left, specifically the eyes behind aviator-style glasses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large face, follows the road line to the glowing city, then moves to the secondary figure and the glowing device.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black space in the upper right and bottom center provides breathing room for the complex subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and charcoal (background and road)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and white (city lights and stars)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and hot pink (rim lighting and glowing device)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark road/space and the luminous city/stars; high saturation in the magenta highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid earthy browns or muted greens
Stick to a cosmic palette of black, magenta, and yellow

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' has a short horizontal bar
The 'R' has a straight diagonal leg

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating above the scene in the black space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both artist name and title to maintain a clean, modern look.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment along the top margin

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and 70s/80s high-end aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a retro-futurist scene with a large portrait of a man with an afro and aviator glasses on the left, a smaller man in a white suit on the right holding a glowing pink cylinder, set against a dark road leading to a glowing yellow city and a starry space background with a planet.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the artist name and title in a white, geometric sans-serif font like Avant Garde, aligned in a single line across the top edge of the image.

verificationChecks: Does the magenta lighting appear as a rim light on the subjects?
Is the city in the background glowing with a yellow/orange haze?
Are the glasses on the foreground figure transparent with realistic reflections?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the magenta rim light
Color of the glowing handheld device
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact layout of the city buildings

mustAchieve: Smooth airbrushed gradients in the sky
High-contrast studio lighting on the subjects

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the road has a clear perspective line
Check that the white text is legible against the dark sky
Verify the dual-scale relationship between the two figures
Confirm the presence of the large planet in the upper center
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Studio Portraiture] with [Airbrushed Cosmic Landscape] + [Geometric Sans-Serif Header] + [Magenta/Yellow/Black Palette].
